proposal: FAR-PIPD-S4EXT-OWNER-OPEN-002: adjudicate the four owner-open items from the S4EXT-R1 round. TT-020/TT-021: the 44 differing evidence-manifest digests are all explained by the seal's as-of plus a CRLF worktree basis (unexplained=0); adopt F-020-A-BASIS so tools/verify_evidence_digests.py classifies each mismatch (MATCH_WORKTREE / EXPLAINED_AT_SEALED_CANDIDATE / EXPLAINED_BY_EOL_BASIS / UNEXPLAINED_DRIFT) and fails --strict only on UNEXPLAINED_DRIFT, plus a documentation correction that the seal's candidate names the seal-time worktree state; reject re-sealing and pruning because they change tracked bytes, the seal digest and crosswalk_digest for no added assurance. Net requirement change: none; every adopted option is report-only or documentation.

challenge_lane: Adversarial lane present and consequential: it FALSIFIED the draft's central claim by testing a line-ending basis the draft had omitted (CRLF of the sealed candidate's blob), collapsing the six unexplained entries to zero and replacing the three-revisions root cause with one seal-time worktree state; it corrected the non-ancestor count from 14 to 21 and showed f541c396 is an ancestor of HEAD and main; it showed the proposed invariant change is a no-op for the tool and a downgrade for the only enforced assertion (T4); and it confirmed the residual exit-3 refusal is correct design. Two caveats it raised are carried as residual risks: the CRLF worktree reading is the best-fitting explanation rather than a proven fact, and the seal names a commit while the entries are a worktree snapshot (one entry postdates the commit by about five minutes).
